newsitem.title: USA: CHICAGO FED JUNE MANUFACTURING INDEX DOWN 0.1 PCT.
newsitem.headline: CHICAGO FED JUNE MANUFACTURING INDEX DOWN 0.1 PCT.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago said on Monday the Chicago Fed Midwest Manufacturing Index (CFMMI) edged down 0.1 percent in June to 121.1.

"June was the second consecutive month that every sector in the region had slower growth from the prior month than its national counterpart," the Chicago Fed said. "The steel sector had the largest decline, falling 1.2 percent from May to June."
The Chicago Fed the auto and machinery sectors both rose, while the resource sector slipped a bit.
The Federal Reserve Board's industrial production index for manufacturing (IPMFG), which measures activity nationwide, rose 0.3 percent in June, the Chicago Fed report said.
The CFMMI index gauges industrial activity in the seventh U.S. economic district, which includes Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Michigan and Wisconsin.
